name: Material graphs: an Unreal-style material editor that generates a shader per material
body:
Dean (2026-11-26): materials get an Unreal-style material graph editor, built on the visual-scripting graph canvas and on material Silhouettes (D-212, D-213). Dean chose a generated shader per material (GLSL, compiled to SPIR-V and MSL at bake time, one lit pipeline per material) over baking values or texture maps.

Asset rule: the graph (`material.graph.json`) lives beside the material Silhouette's `root.calamus` in the game project folder. The built game never reads it or Calamus: the bake writes the generated GLSL and its compiled shaders into `game-assets/`, and `BakedMaterials.nyx` registers them.
